name: CMP Full Theos Build (No Freezes)
postCreateCommand: apt-get update && apt-get install -y git make clang lld zip unzip fakeroot rpm dpkg-dev libssl-dev libbz2-dev libdb-dev libreadline-dev libsqlite3-dev libncurses5-dev libncursesw5-dev libffi-dev liblzma-dev sudo && export THEOS=$(pwd)/theos && echo 'export THEOS=$(pwd)/theos' >> ~/.bashrc && echo 'alias make="make -j8"' >> ~/.bashrc && $THEOS/bin/bin/install-sdk || true && cd $(pwd) && make clean && make package || echo 'Build ready on rebuild'
